definitions.explanation: To cut into something and break it apart, especially terrain or material.

definitions.gloss: to draw on, to dip into (savings)
definitions.explanation: To gradually use up saved resources; to spend money from savings.
To weaken or divide something from within; to erode support or unity.

notes:
{切|き}り{崩|くず}す is a compound verb: ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut) + ⟦{崩|くず}す→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧ (to crumble). The two together give the image of breaking something down piece by piece, which is why the verb covers both physical excavation (sense 1) and the gradual depletion of a resource (sense 2) or of a group's unity (sense 3).

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧). Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{崩|くず}す.

ASPECT (ている):
{切|き}り{崩|くず}している describes the action in progress, and in sense 2 it is the normal form for an ongoing situation — ⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{崩|くず}している ('I am living off my savings').

COMMON PATTERNS:
・⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{崩|くず}す - to dip into savings
・⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{崩|くず}す - to cut into a mountain
・⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{崩|くず}す - to break down the opposition
